info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Routes-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Routes Listing API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of available rideshare routes within the platform. This endpoint provides essential data to developers seeking to integrate rideshare functionality into their applications or services. Typical consumers include mobile app developers, transportation service providers, and logistics companies. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance user experiences and facilitate efficient route planning for rideshare operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the optimal route for a specific ride based on given parameters. Useful for applications that need to provide navigation or travel solutions.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the route of rides. This should include all necessary parameters and options to specify the desired route details.
